decisions.reason: The shop template costs little to maintain, sits close to the agency-focused hosting offer, and the firm has already put it on its website, so management sees little reason to retract it despite its modest visibility.
Like the shop template, the responsive website template is a low-cost extension of the core offer that the firm has publicly listed, and dropping it would bring little relief.
Premium support directly embodies the round-the-clock expert support the firm promises, so withdrawing it would contradict its announced direction.
The firm built the version management tool with its own development effort and gave it a dedicated page, and it fits the strategy of tools that reduce recurring work, so commitment to it is strong.

The data processing contract tool is distant from the core offer, but the firm invested in a whole product line and presented it on its own page, and weak early demand can be blamed on temporary GDPR-transition effects, so management persists with it.
